clarifications: Ask about borrowing eligibility or member loan limits.
Ask about access to borrowing and own current loans.
must_preserve: Own current loans rather than all member loans.
must_not_infer: A library representative is a product user solely because they advise the project.
Fines, reservations, renewal, email or payment as confirmed scope.

required_facts.meaning: Create and update book-copy records as a librarian.
Browse available copies as a member or visitor without mandatory sign-in.
Borrow an available copy as a signed-in member.
View only own current loans as a signed-in member.
Record a return as a librarian.
Prevent two active loans for the same copy.
Make a returned copy available again.
Limit members to three active loans and refuse a fourth without creating a loan.

after_clarification.constraint: First release due six weeks after requirements approval.

specification.must_preserve: All original and clarified in-scope facts, actors and conditions.
specification.traceability: Facts link to the brief or actually supplied user reply. Proposed assumptions are labeled.

checks: Every implementable requirement is covered by a task.
Tasks preserve role permissions, three-loan limit and copy-level availability.

acceptance_criteria.coverage: All implementable requirements have meaningful testable criteria. Below are mandatory scenario meanings, not an exhaustive generated output.

required_scenarios.given: A signed-in member has fewer than three active loans and a copy is available.
required_scenarios.then: One active loan for that member and copy is created, and the copy is no longer available.

required_scenarios.given: A member has three active loans and another copy is available.
required_scenarios.when: The member tries to borrow that copy.
required_scenarios.then: The attempt is refused and the member still has exactly three active loans.

required_scenarios.given: Members A and B each have an active loan.
required_scenarios.when: Signed-in member A views their current loans.
required_scenarios.then: Only member A loans are shown.

required_scenarios.given: A copy has an active loan.
required_scenarios.then: The loan is no longer active and the copy is available.

required_scenarios.given: A copy has an active loan.
required_scenarios.when: Another member tries to borrow it.
required_scenarios.then: No second active loan is created.

required_scenarios.given: A visitor is signed out and a copy is available.
required_scenarios.then: The copy is shown without requiring sign-in.

required_scenarios.when: The visitor attempts to borrow a copy.
required_scenarios.then: Borrowing cannot complete and no loan is created before sign-in.

additional_checks: Creation and updating of book copies both have criteria.
Avoid invented error message text, automatic redirection, fines or loan due dates.

structural_checks: At least one R per activity; same role may be A and R.
Implementation tasks are covered by implementation responsibility.
Governance activities may have empty task references.
raci.stakeholder_check: Library representative participation in UAT is preserved. Consulted participation is acceptable; do not invent final approval authority.

end_to_end: After verified answers and owner approval, all four document outputs are produced.
Documents consistently enforce the same rules.
No fabricated source references or edited quotes.
